thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT [P1] GPU OOM surge (prefill) detected on cluster: redwood-prod-gpu. Autopager triggered and paging current oncall. Incident: https://redwood/incidents/5867123456 :rotating_light:

maria: Noted. Seeing repeated container restarts on pool gpu-prod-3 — ~15 restarts in last 6m. Appears correlated with very long-context prefill requests (customer payloads with ~40-60k tokens). Paging @jordan @lee for runtime triage.

jordan: Can you paste the last container log (stderr) from one of the crashes?

maria: Sure — pasted the relevant lines below:
```
[2026-03-17T00:12:03Z] model-server[pid=2345]: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 2.1 GiB (GPU 0; 24.0 GiB total, 22.4 GiB free)
stack: /opt/runtime/serve/kv_cache.cc:112
[2026-03-17T00:12:04Z] kubelet: Container exited with status OOMKilled
[2026-03-17T00:12:05Z] model-server: prefill tokens: 61234, batch_size: 1, kv_cache_size: 14.2 GB
```

lee: Looks like prefill explosion + KV cache growth. Quick mitigations we can apply now:
1) enable PREFILL_TRIMMER to drop historic context beyond 32k tokens for routes flagged as long-context.
2) set max_prefill_tokens=16000 for those routes.
3) map heavy traffic to quantized model variant (cold/float16) as fallback.
I'll prepare a hotpatch for (1)+(2).

maria: I'm going to apply an emergency rate-limit on the relevant routes to slow the surge: /generate/long-context and /chat/llarge. Plan: 1rps per key for 30m, plus immediate KV eviction on restart. @ops-bot please apply policy to cluster gpu-prod-3 now.

ops-bot: rate-limit policy 'prefill-protect' applied to cluster gpu-prod-3 at 00:17 UTC by maria. Rolling restarts suppressed. :white_check_mark:

jordan: Also recommend mapping affected customers to coldmodel-1 (CPU fallback) for any single request with >20k prefill tokens. That avoids OOM and gives soft degradation instead of container restarts. We can do route override or customer-targeted mapping.

maria: Customer impact summary: 3 enterprise customers on long-context beta affected. ~42 failed requests in the last 15m (502/504). No broad outage for short-context routes. Notifying CSE/AE now with a draft: "We observed memory pressure causing retries for very long inputs; temporary limits and fallbacks applied; investigating root cause and next steps."

maria: Handover summary for next oncall (sam) in ~15m: GPU OOMs caused by prefill long-context; mitigations applied: rate-limit rule 'prefill-protect', KV eviction on restart, mapping heavy requests to coldmodel fallback. Actions for next oncall: monitor restart rate, GPU memory pressure (node exporter -> gpu_memory_used), verify fallback mapping, consider autoscale (add-one) or node drain if crashes continue. Links: https://redwood/incidents/5867123456 | runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/prefill-oom

sam: Taking it for the next window. I'll keep current mitigations and enable an add-one scale for gpu-prod-3 if restart rate > 5/min for 10m. If restarts don't drop after the throttles, I'll coordinate a controlled node drain to repro and capture core dumps. Will also follow up with a short customer update after stabilization.

maria: Thanks — tagging postmortem channel when stable. :thumbsup:
